scenes.scene_description: Snow-covered Himalayan peaks rise into the heavens, shrouded in mist and glowing softly under celestial light.
scenes.background: Himalayan mountain range, clouds drifting low
scenes.action: Establishing shot of serene, icy landscape where time feels suspended

scenes.scene_description: Shiva sits motionless at the mountain’s edge, wrapped in tiger skin, body smeared with ash, radiating divine calm.
scenes.background: Rocky mountain ledge, faint aura surrounding Shiva
scenes.action: Camera slowly pans in on Shiva’s still form

scenes.scene_description: His thick matted hair rises like coiled serpents, a stream of the Ganga pouring from the locks with divine flow.
scenes.background: Hair illuminated with a holy glow, water glistening mid-air
scenes.action: Close-up on hair, revealing flowing Ganga with soft mist

scenes.scene_description: The crescent moon shines from his forehead, and his third eye glows faintly with fiery energy.
scenes.background: Forehead glowing with cosmic symbols and light
scenes.action: Zoom to brow, showing pulsing third eye and moonlight reflection

scenes.scene_description: Time itself holds its breath—snowflakes float mid-air, frozen before they touch the ground.
scenes.background: Silent snowy cliffside, particles frozen in space
scenes.action: Slow-motion shot of hovering snowflakes around Shiva

scenes.scene_description: Shiva beats a small damaru, its rhythm shaking the fabric of time with each pulse.
scenes.background: Vibrating air, glowing sound ripples through space
scenes.action: Focus on damaru as beats create visible time waves

scenes.scene_description: Each drumbeat births time itself, while the pauses end cosmic cycles in silence.
scenes.background: Shimmering time-threads forming and vanishing around him
scenes.action: Transition between pulses and silences shaping existence

scenes.scene_description: Nandi, Shiva’s loyal bull, rests near him like a divine statue carved by eternal devotion.
scenes.background: Sacred rock platform beside Shiva, faint golden light on Nandi
scenes.action: Still frame of Nandi with gentle divine glow, unmoving and watchful

scenes.scene_description: Suddenly, a serpent glides across Shiva’s shoulders, its body shimmering with ancient runes.
scenes.background: Close-up of Shiva's upper body, serpent in motion
scenes.action: Serpent slithers in slow, graceful motion with glowing patterns

scenes.scene_description: The serpent hisses, its sound echoing like the voice of the void.
scenes.background: Air trembles as the hiss warps the silence
scenes.action: Camera zooms on serpent’s mouth as it emits a deep, echoing hiss

scenes.scene_description: With a deep breath, Shiva opens his eyes—storms rise, galaxies ripple through his gaze.
scenes.background: Explosive cosmic visuals behind him, sky darkens
scenes.action: Shiva’s eyes flash open, triggering massive universal tremors

scenes.scene_description: He closes his eyes again; silence reigns and creation folds back into stillness.
scenes.background: Still Himalayan scene returns, snow settles softly
scenes.action: Galaxies vanish, light dims, world returns to calm with Shiva’s exhale
